pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Waste food daily

2. Which response best shows understanding of The Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use The Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Holy Bible.
   D. Say The Holy Bible has no place in daily life.

3. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

4. Which response best shows understanding of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top.

5. Which response best shows understanding of The Sinai Covenant? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Sinai Covenant to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Sinai Covenant.
   C. Say The Sinai Covenant has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Sinai Covenant with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Stewardship Over Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Use Stewardship Over Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stewardship Over Creation.
   C. Apply the teaching of Stewardship Over Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Stewardship Over Creation has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of The Old Testament Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Old Testament Prophets has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Old Testament Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use The Old Testament Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Old Testament Prophets.

8. Which response best shows understanding of The Exodus? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Exodus with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say The Exodus has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Exodus.
   D. Use The Exodus to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Loyalty to God? (1 mark)
   A. Use Loyalty to God to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Loyalty to God.
   C. Say Loyalty to God has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Loyalty to God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Teachings of Prophet Amos? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Teachings of Prophet Amos with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Teachings of Prophet Amos has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Teachings of Prophet Amos.
   D. Use Teachings of Prophet Amos to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

12. Which response best shows understanding of Background of Prophet Amos? (1 mark)
   A. Use Background of Prophet Amos to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Background of Prophet Amos with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Background of Prophet Amos.
   D. Say Background of Prophet Amos has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Human Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Human Sexuality 4.4 Marriage and Family 4.5 Christian Response to Modern Medicin and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Human Sexuality and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Marriage and Family and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

2. A — Apply the teaching of The Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. D — Telling the truth and keeping trust

4. A — Apply the teaching of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. D — Apply the teaching of The Sinai Covenant with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. C — Apply the teaching of Stewardship Over Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. B — Apply the teaching of The Old Testament Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. A — Apply the teaching of The Exodus with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. D — Apply the teaching of Loyalty to God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. A — Apply the teaching of Teachings of Prophet Amos with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. B — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

12. B — Apply the teaching of Background of Prophet Amos with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Human Rights; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Human Sexuality 4.4 Marriage and Family 4.5 Christian Response to Modern Medicin; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Human Sexuality; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Marriage and Family; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
